question: What protection against poison results in the body even after bites from great serpents?
premises: The body may be bitten by great serpents
Poison would normally enter the body
Poison does not enter in this case
inference: As a result of the practice, poison does not enter the body even when bitten by great serpents.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
